visual_action: A fast-paced montage of clips showing Donald Trump during his presidency. The video includes scenes of Trump walking through the White House, meeting with world leaders and business executives, interacting with supporters and children, and signing documents. Interspersed are thematic B-roll clips: U.S. Border Patrol agents and vehicles at the border, various scenes of U.S. military personnel and equipment in action, American factory workers, and iconic Washington D.C. locations like the Capitol building and the White House. The video ends with shots of fireworks over D.C. monuments.
